# Test that c://pkg: imports with a nonexistent library fail the build.
# The error message mentioning pkg-config is surfaced via the returned error.

! sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out .
! exists out/model.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/ctest

go 1.21

-- main.sngl --
import lib "c://pkg:nonexistent-lib-xyz-9999"

component main {
  window #app {
    text "hello"
  }
}
